Usage:  toolctl <verb> <options>
        toolctl <verb> with no options prints the verb usage.

Verbs:
   list                 (List the items of a volume)
   info[rmation]        (Show the details of an item)
   eraseDisk            (Wipe a whole disk)
   mount <volume>       (Attach a volume to the tree)
   Info                 (Capitalised names are dropped)

For more help run toolctl <verb> without arguments.
